usage: UI concept exploration only; not production imagery or implemented screens
prompt_composition: shared_prompt followed by the matching concept prompt
shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity graphic-design concept board for Calgary Crocs, an underwater hockey club app. This is a UI style exploration, not an implementation. Landscape composition, two large straight-on mobile UI artboards side by side, no physical phone hardware, no perspective, no laptop, no promotional paragraph. Small concept name at top. Artboards must be large and legible, fill most of image. Left screen Home: small brand text "CALGARY CROCS", greeting "Hi Alex", an expressive but compact club-identity header, section "Next practice", date block "THU 29 OCT", event title "Thursday training" with tiny chevron linking details, "7:45–9:30 PM", "MNP Sport Centre", compact attendance rows "You" "Sam" "Mila" with clear separate Yes / No buttons (selected Yes green, selected No restrained red), then a right-aligned row of real buttons "Attendance", "Plan", "Teams". Below, a small "Club news" section with "Welcome to the new season". Bottom navigation Home / Schedule / Messages / Account / Club. Right screen Account: name Alex Rivera, sibling tabs "Progress" and "Feedback" with Feedback selected; clearly separated sections "Your reflections" with "Reflect" action, "Coach ratings" with a compact "Thursday training" row and score "8/10", "Coach notes" with "Great support play. Keep moving after the pass.", and a "Videos" row with a small abstract pool-video thumbnail and "Passing review". Match one coherent design system across both screens. Practical touch-sized controls, clear contrast, readable deliberate typography, clean hierarchy, not a mass of identical rounded panels. Add life through art direction and selective graphic treatments, not clutter. Do not add invented features, graphs, streaks, rankings, trophies, fitness weights, payment features or excessive microcopy. Avoid hockey sticks, ice hockey, skates, distorted sports equipment, ornate fake logos, glassmorphism, generic purple SaaS gradients. No watermark.

concepts.prompt: Concept name "01 / AQUATIC EDITORIAL". Swiss editorial sports identity: warm ivory background, deep navy type, vivid cobalt, pool-tile cyan, small club-green accents. Oversized elegant condensed grotesk headlines paired with highly legible neutral sans body; strict typographic grid, fine divider rules, beautiful asymmetrical but functional spacing. One confident cropped photograph of real rippling turquoise pool water, integrated as a narrow horizontal masthead with oversized outlined lane numerals and an angular cobalt date tab. White/ivory practical content; result numbers crisp, minimal rounding; restrained graphic blocks and pool-lane geometry. Sophisticated independent sports magazine translated into a very usable app. Bright daylight, energetic and premium, not an empty minimalist banking UI.

Concept name "02 / RETRO SWIM CLUB". Warm, joyful 1970s community swim-club print identity: cream paper-like base, dark pine green lettering, vivid tangerine and turquoise accent panels, butter-yellow highlights. Distinctive chunky rounded display lettering and sturdy readable sans body. Flat screenprint-style abstract water ripples, wavy borders used in only the compact masthead, a small circular typographic club badge. Subtle print texture only on decorative art, never behind small UI text. Warm social energy, pool tickets and club noticeboard inspiration; rectangular compact date ticket, generous white space. Use playful controlled asymmetry, simple crisp icons, slightly rounded actionable buttons. No childish cartoons, no distressed illegible type. Visually very different from editorial and dark-tech designs.

Concept name "03 / NIGHT SWIM". Premium atmospheric evening pool identity, dark ink/navy rather than flat muddy green, electric aquatic teal and ultramarine light, small acid-lime action accents, luminous off-white readable type. A carefully cropped photoreal pool surface at night forms a compact beautiful header, with subtle caustic light geometry and clean overlaid club typography. Crisp modern neo-grotesk with large confident title, narrow tabular date figures, disciplined thin lines and layered ink-blue surfaces. Some content areas have no card border; one featured practice area feels intentional. Soft aqua highlight on selected controls, restrained neutral inactive controls; no large glows, no glowing text, no grain noise, no glass cards, no cyberpunk or gaming HUD. Refined aquatic atmosphere with human club warmth and practical everyday UI.

Concept name "04 / MEET SCOREBOARD". Expressive contemporary sports-poster / controlled neo-brutalist graphic design: bold near-black and warm white, sharp cobalt blue and tennis-yellow blocks, small green attendance state. Oversized condensed athletic grotesk titles, large date numerals, monospaced/tabular numerals only for time/score, visible black grid rules, square-edged containers, small purposeful offset hard shadows on primary buttons. Inspired by swim meet timing boards and event tickets, not a generic dashboard. Strong compositional rhythm, cropped graphic stripes in the masthead, yellow date slab with black text. Right screen score 8/10 becomes a clear typographic focal point without overwhelming notes. Intentional functional density, flat graphic surfaces, accessible contrast. Bold and alive while still clear, no grunge, no excessive slogans, no irrelevant badges or trophies.

Concept name "05 / ILLUSTRATED CLUBHOUSE". Contemporary friendly Scandinavian/indie community art direction: airy warm off-white, rich evergreen text, saturated mint/seafoam, soft periwinkle, peach and coral accents. Humanist sans with gently expressive medium-weight display type. A compact custom flat-illustrated header of abstract overlapping swimmers' silhouettes, water-ripple cut-paper shapes and pool lane lines, sophisticated editorial illustration with limited palette, not clip art or emoji. Small varied colored member avatar circles, carefully chosen colored section markers and one pale-tint note panel. Organic illustration balanced by beautifully aligned compact lists and clear direct controls. Joyful, inclusive all-ages club feeling, tactile matte color shapes, minimal shadows, no photography, no dark mode, no 3D plastic, no excessive pill capsules. Make it visibly distinct from retro screenprint: contemporary clean humanist typography and airy illustration-led layout.
